title.zh: Evernorth 通过与 Armada 合并登陆纳斯达克并选定机构合作伙伴部署 XRP 储备
title.en: Evernorth shareholders approve $1 billion XRP treasury deal, clearing path to Nasdaq debut

current_state.zh: 纳斯达克上市的Evernorth已选择Ripple、Kraken、Coinbase和BitGo作为其首批机构合作伙伴，从第四季度开始部署约4.73亿枚XRP（约6.48亿美元），后续将扩展到XRP Ledger借贷和链上DeFi策略，由前Coinbase Asset Management联合首席投资官Hugo Jeandesboz领导。
current_state.en: Nasdaq-listed Evernorth has selected Ripple, Kraken, Coinbase and BitGo as its first institutional partners to deploy roughly 473 million XRP (about $648 million) starting in Q4, with later expansion into XRP Ledger lending and on-chain DeFi strategies led by former Coinbase Asset Management co-CIO Hugo Jeandesboz.

updates.what_changed_zh: Evernorth 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. II 的合并，并宣布将于 10 月 12 日在纳斯达克以 XRPN 开始交易；交易完成后持有约 4.73 亿枚 XRP 及约 3 亿美元现金总收益。

updates.current_state_en: Evernorth has completed its merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and is set to begin trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN on Oct. 12, 2026; it holds roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: XRP treasury firm Evernorth Holdings completed its merger with SPAC Armada Acquisition Corp. II and will begin trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12, holding roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.detailed_summary_en: XRP treasury firm Evernorth Holdings completed its merger with SPAC Armada Acquisition Corp. II and will begin trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12, holding roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash proceeds.
updates.background_zh: SPAC 即“空白支票公司”，是通过 IPO 募集资金的已上市壳公司，需在特定期限内收购一家私人公司或与之合并，合并正是目标公司实现上市的方式。Evernorth 此前已向 SEC 递交文件，推进纳斯达克上市进程，并与基础设施服务商 t54 合作管理其 XRP 财库。
updates.background_en: A SPAC, or blank-check company, is a listed shell that raises money through an IPO in order to acquire or merge with a private company within a set timeframe; the merger is how the target becomes publicly listed. Evernorth had earlier filed with the SEC as it moved toward a Nasdaq listing, and has worked with infrastructure provider t54 on managing its XRP treasury.
updates.market_impact_zh: XRPN 为机构和公开市场投资者提供了一只以 XRP 计价的财库与收益策略载体，其传导路径主要通过股票市场准入、托管与 XRP 增持，而非交易所层面的整体流动性。该事件也关系到更广泛的上市数字资产财库公司群体，这些公司正在争夺同一批机构资金。
updates.market_impact_en: XRPN gives institutional and public-market investors a listed vehicle whose treasury and yield strategies are denominated in XRP, so the transmission path runs through equity-market access, custody and XRP accumulation rather than through exchange-wide liquidity. The story is also relevant to the broader segment of listed digital-asset treasury companies competing for the same institutional capital.

updates.title_zh: Ripple支持的Evernorth登陆纳斯达克，持有4.73亿枚XRP，价值远低于其买入成本
updates.title_en: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增事实：Evernorth 与 Armada Acquisition Corp. II 的合并于10月9日完成，10月12日在纳斯达克首日交易；约80.3%公众股东赎回约1.95亿美元，导致流通盘稀薄；XRP 从签约时2.37美元跌至1.43美元参考价，使财库估值约6.77亿美元，低于最初宣称的超10亿美元募资；SBI Holdings 控制39.9%投票权，Arrington Capital 基金持19.9%，Chris Larsen 关联9.9%，Ripple 及关联方上限9.9%并有六个月锁定期至2027年4月。
updates.what_changed_en: New facts: the Evernorth-Armada Acquisition Corp. II merger closed on Oct. 9 and began trading on Nasdaq on Oct. 12; about 80.3% of public shareholders redeemed roughly $195 million, leaving a thin float; XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price, marking the treasury at about $677 million versus the originally touted more than $1 billion raise; SBI Holdings controls 39.9% of voting shares, Arrington Capital's fund holds 19.9%, Chris Larsen is tied to 9.9%, and Ripple and affiliates are capped at 9.9% with six-month lock-ups until April 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Evernorth 已完成与 Armada Acquisition Corp. II 的 SPAC 合并，并于2026年10月12日开始在纳斯达克以 XRPN 交易；持有约4.73亿枚 XRP 和约3亿美元现金。约80.3%公众股东赎回，抽走约1.95亿美元；XRP 参考价1.43美元使财库估值约6.77亿美元，低于最初募资承诺超10亿美元；SBI 持39.9%投票权，Arrington 19.9%，Larsen 9.9%，Ripple 及关联方上限9.9%并有六个月锁定期至2027年4月。
updates.current_state_en: Evernorth completed its SPAC merger with Armada Acquisition Corp. II and began trading on Nasdaq under XRPN on October 12, 2026, holding about 473 million XRP and roughly $300 million in cash. About 80.3% of public shareholders redeemed, pulling out about $195 million; the $1.43 XRP reference price values the treasury at about $677 million, below the originally touted more than $1 billion raise; SBI holds 39.9% of voting shares, Arrington 19.9%, Larsen 9.9%, and Ripple and affiliates are capped at 9.9% with six-month lock-ups until April 2027.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN after closing its SPAC merger, holding roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million cash, with its treasury marked at about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion it raised — after XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under ticker XRPN after closing its SPAC merger, holding roughly 473 million XRP and $300 million cash, with its treasury marked at about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion it raised — after XRP fell from $2.37 at signing to a $1.43 reference price.
updates.background_zh: Evernorth属于被称为“数字资产储备公司”（DAT）的一类公司：其主营业务是持有某种加密货币并募集资金继续买入，这一模式由Strategy（原Microstrategy）以比特币率先开创。该模式依赖一个名为mNAV（市值对净资产价值比）的指标，即公司市值除以其持有加密资产的价值；高于1时，DAT可以溢价发行新股并买入更多代币，低于1时募资则意味着稀释。Evernorth称其目前是专注于XRP的最大上市企业。该公司在2025年10月下旬斥资约9.47亿美元买入XRP，到今年2月这批持仓的价值比买入成本低约4.46亿美元；XRP在2025年7月创下3.65美元的历史高点，1.43美元的交割参考价较该峰值低约61%。
updates.background_en: Evernorth belongs to a crowded category known as digital asset treasuries (DATs): public companies whose main business is holding a cryptocurrency and raising money to buy more of it, a playbook pioneered by Strategy (formerly Microstrategy) with Bitcoin. The model turns on a ratio called mNAV — market-to-net-asset value — which divides a company's stock market value by the value of the crypto it holds; above 1 a DAT can issue shares at a premium and buy more tokens, while below 1 raising money means dilution. Evernorth says it is now the largest publicly traded company devoted to XRP. It spent roughly $947 million buying XRP in late October 2025, and by February that holding was worth about $446 million less than it paid; XRP hit an all-time high of $3.65 in July 2025, and the $1.43 closing reference price sits about 61% below that peak.
updates.market_impact_zh: XRPN为券商投资者提供了一条通过纳斯达克股票获得XRP敞口的路径，这一渠道经由股权而非现货加密市场传导；此次交易的高赎回率和参考价从2.37美元跌至1.43美元，直接影响市场对数字资产储备模式及其mNAV经济性在XRP相关及其他加密储备公司上的评价。赎回后极小的流通盘也意味着XRPN股价会因小额订单而剧烈波动，因此其股价表现并不能直接等同于XRP本身的市场状况。
updates.market_impact_en: XRPN creates a Nasdaq-listed equity route into XRP exposure for brokerage investors, a channel that runs through equity rather than spot crypto venues; the deal's heavy redemption and the fall in the reference price from $2.37 to $1.43 feed directly into how the digital-asset-treasury model and its mNAV economics are judged for XRP-linked and other crypto treasury vehicles. The thin post-redemption float also means XRPN's share price can move on small order flow, so its trading is not a clean read-through to XRP's own market.
